mike: Heads-up — p99 latency +12% on llama3-13b after yesterday's kernel-selector patch. Spotted on dedicated hosts, steady repro across three instances. Perf bot also alerted: <https://perf.internal/alerts/8472|alert-8472>.

perf-bot: alert: latency_regression (model=llama3-13b, env=dedicated) p95=412ms p99=823ms (baseline p99=733ms) change=+12.4%
  repro-cmd: `infra/bench/run --model llama3-13b --seq 2048 --batch 8 --profile flame --runs 50`

jules: Noted. I merged the selector change that prefers fused RMSNorm+SiLU kernel for head_dim multiples of 64 (PR #6221). Hypothesis: fused path increases prefetch stride on our matmul kernels and interacts poorly with current rope_theta defaults — causes more KV cache misses for long chats.

sara: I ran a quick A/B. With `--kernel-selector=legacy` p99 goes back to ~735ms. With fused path p99 ~825ms. Quick numbers:
  - legacy: p50=28ms p95=408ms p99=736ms
  - fused:  p50=32ms p95=420ms p99=825ms
  logs: `evict_rate=0.003` (legacy) vs `evict_rate=0.012` (fused)

anna: KV eviction jump is the suspicious bit. Stack traces from the failing runs show repeated KV reload hotloops and more memcpy activity in the kernel hotpath. Snippet from `perf script`:
```
  0x7f8a2c kernel_fused_rms_silu
  0x7f8a9d matmul_prefetch
  0x7f8b01 kv_cache_reload
```
Also noticed chat-template sessions with rolling prefixes >1500 tokens show worst regressions.

jules: That matches my local microprofile: fused kernel reduces compute cycles for single token but increases L2 miss rate by ~3x for our access pattern when head_dim=64 and rope_theta default=10000. I swapped `rope_theta` to 8192 in a local run and p99 improved ~6%.

sara: Reproduced: run with `--rope-theta 8192` (override) gives p99=775ms on fused path. Not back to baseline but much better. Suggests rope scaling interacts with cache indexing (our KV stride uses rope_theta-derived offsets).

mike: So actionable items? Revert selector or add safety gate for fused kernel when (rope_theta != family-default) or chat_template=true?

jules: Proposed plan:
  1) revert the automatic promotion in selector for canary (opt-in) within next hour (PR ready: #6230).
  2) add a runtime guard: avoid fused RMSNorm+SiLU kernel for sessions with long prefix OR when rope_theta != model-default (ticket 6789).
  3) perf team to run full regression matrix across head_dim {32,64,128}, rope_theta {512,8192,10000} and batch sizes {1,4,8} and produce flamegraphs.

anna: I'll dump flamegraphs to the perf bucket and tag them in the ticket: gs://redwood-perf/llama3/2026-03-18/ (flame links posted in the ticket). Also will add evict_rate and kv-reload counters to the per-request trace.

perf-bot: regression-label: confirmed. linked PRs: #6230 (revert), #6231 (selector-guard). opened issue: 6789.

sara: Quick note — Mixtral configs show similar but smaller regression (p99 +4%) under fused path; Mistral didn't show uplift. So this is model-sensitive — probably tied to hidden/head dimensionality and layernorm placement.

mike: OK let's do the revert canary and run the regression matrix. Jules/Anna/Sara — please coordinate on the ticket and paste any small repro scripts in the PR. I'll notify infra to hold large-scale deploys until we confirm. :thumbsup:

jules: Will open the revert canary in the next 30m and post the runbook. Assigning to @sara and @anna for validation. Closing loop here, will update ticket 6789 with flamegraph diffs and final recommendation.
